# llms.txt — https://csoai.org
# Council of AI (CSOAI Ltd, UK 16939677)
# Independent measurement body for AI behaviour.
# We measure, sign, and re-attest. Everyone can check.
# Verified measurement credential — never certification. Not a notified body.

## Canonical surfaces
- [Home](https://csoai.org): measurement body landing
- [councilof.ai](https://councilof.ai): flagship
- [Signed scoreboard](https://councilof.ai/gspc-scoreboard)
- [Verify](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify): free, loginless
- [Council Space](https://councilof.ai/gspc-arena): AI vs AI spectator
- [GSPC API](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc): live axis register (13 measured; public grid is 15 slots, extras unmeasured)

## What we are not
- Not a certification body
- Not a notified body
- No money either direction with anything we rank
- No BFT-33 / 33-seat / Care Floor claims
- SOVOS / SOVEREIGN / sov-* are internal names and are not public chrome
